target.title: Add local Claw feed planning
target.body:
## Summary

Stacked after #101328. This adds the first read-only Claw feed layer so OpenClaw can discover a Claw from a feed entry and build the same lifecycle plan introduced in PR2.

Design reference: RFC PR https://github.com/openclaw/rfcs/pull/27

- adds `openclaw.clawFeed.v1` types, strict parsing, and local feed file reading
- resolves feed entries to local Claw manifest sources with source-locality checks
- adds owner/trust metadata on feed entries and warnings for missing owner evidence
- adds `openclaw claws feed inspect <feed>` and `openclaw claws feed plan <feed> <claw>`
- keeps PR3 read-only: remote feed fetch, install, mutation, and ClawHub publish/search stay deferred

## Safety / ownership behavior

- relative feed sources must stay under the feed file directory
- absolute local paths are rejected
- remote `http`/`https` sources are rejected in this PR
- `file:` URLs are accepted only if they resolve under the feed directory
- feed entry id must match the resolved manifest id
- feed entry version mismatch is diagnostic-only warning so feeds can surface drift without mutating anything

## Verification

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/claws/schema.test.ts src/claws/feed.test.ts src/cli/claws-cli.test.ts src/cli/program/command-registry.test.ts src/cli/program/root-command-descriptions.test.ts`
- `git diff --check`
- `node scripts/check-no-conflict-markers.mjs`
- `OPENCLAW_DISABLE_BUNDLED_PLUGINS=1 OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR=/tmp/openclaw-claws-pr3-proof-state node --import tsx src/entry.ts claws feed inspect src/claws/fixtures/local-claws.feed.json --json`
- `OPENCLAW_DISABLE_BUNDLED_PLUGINS=1 OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR=/tmp/openclaw-claws-pr3-proof-state node --import tsx src/entry.ts claws feed plan src/claws/fixtures/local-claws.feed.json incident-response --json`
- `node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --ignoreConfig --noEmit --pretty false --target ES2022 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --strict --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck --types node src/claws/feed.ts src/claws/types.ts src/claws/schema.ts src/claws/plan.ts src/claws/reader.ts src/cli/claws-cli.ts src/cli/claws-cli.runtime.ts`
- `codex review -c model=gpt-5.5 --base origin/user/giodl/claws-pr2-schema-plan` returned no actionable correctness issues after fixing its path-confinement findings.


## Real behavior proof

Behavior or issue addressed:
This PR adds read-only local Claw feed inspection and feed-to-Claw planning so OpenClaw can parse an `openclaw.clawFeed.v1` file, resolve a local Claw manifest entry under the feed directory, and emit the same read-only Claw plan shape from PR2 without installing or mutating state.

Real environment tested:
WSL Ubuntu checkout at `/root/src/openclaw-claws-pr3`, branch `user/giodl/claws-pr3-feed-plan`, commit `4896f53a711`. Runtime used the source harness with `node --import tsx src/entry.ts`, `OPENCLAW_DISABLE_BUNDLED_PLUGINS=1`, and isolated `OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR=/tmp/openclaw-claws-pr3-proof-state`.

Exact steps or command run after this patch:
1. `OPENCLAW_DISABLE_BUNDLED_PLUGINS=1 OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR=/tmp/openclaw-claws-pr3-proof-state node --import tsx src/entry.ts claws feed inspect src/claws/fixtures/local-claws.feed.json --json`
2. `OPENCLAW_DISABLE_BUNDLED_PLUGINS=1 OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR=/tmp/openclaw-claws-pr3-proof-state node --import tsx src/entry.ts claws feed plan src/claws/fixtures/local-claws.feed.json incident-response --json`

Evidence after fix:
`claws feed inspect` emitted this current-head JSON:

```json
{
  "valid": true,
  "sourcePath": "/root/src/openclaw-claws-pr3/src/claws/fixtures/local-claws.feed.json",
  "feed": {
    "schemaVersion": "openclaw.clawFeed.v1",
    "id": "local-starter-claws",
    "name": "Local Starter Claws",
    "publisher": "openclaw.examples",
    "description": "Local feed fixture for read-only Claw discovery and planning.",
    "generatedAt": "2026-07-07T00:00:00.000Z",
    "entries": [
      {
        "id": "incident-response",
        "name": "Incident Response",
        "version": "1.0.0",
        "source": "incident-response.claw.json",
        "publisher": "openclaw.examples",
        "description": "Starter claw for triage, workspace context, and response automation.",
        "owner": {
          "type": "publisher",
          "id": "openclaw.examples"
        },
        "trust": {
          "level": "source"
        }
      }
    ]
  },
  "diagnostics": []
}
```

`claws feed plan` emitted this current-head JSON:

```json
{
  "schemaVersion": "openclaw.clawPlan.v1",
  "readOnly": true,
  "claw": {
    "id": "incident-response",
    "name": "Incident Response",
    "version": "1.0.0",
    "sourcePath": "/root/src/openclaw-claws-pr3/src/claws/fixtures/incident-response.claw.json"
  },
  "summary": {
    "totalEntries": 5,
    "requiredEntries": 4,
    "optionalEntries": 1,
    "requiresConsent": 2,
    "unsupportedOptionalEntries": 0
  },
  "entries": [
    {
      "id": "incident-triage-skill",
      "kind": "skill",
      "required": true,
      "decision": "inspectOnly",
      "target": "clawhub:incident-triage@1.0.0",
      "reason": "This PR only validates and plans local claw manifests; install resolution is intentionally deferred."
    },
    {
      "id": "pager-duty-plugin",
      "kind": "plugin",
      "required": true,
      "decision": "inspectOnly",
      "target": "npm:@openclaw/plugin-pager-duty@2.4.0",
      "reason": "This PR only validates and plans local claw manifests; install resolution is intentionally deferred."
    },
    {
      "id": "statuspage-mcp",
      "kind": "mcpServer",
      "required": false,
      "decision": "inspectOnly",
      "target": "clawhub:statuspage-mcp@1.1.0",
      "reason": "This PR only validates and plans local claw manifests; install resolution is intentionally deferred."
    },
    {
      "id": "runbook",
      "kind": "workspaceFile",
      "required": true,
      "decision": "requiresConsent",
      "target": "SOUL.md",
      "source": "files/SOUL.md",
      "reason": "This entry would require explicit user consent before a future install command mutates workspace files or automation state."
    },
    {
      "id": "heartbeat-summary",
      "kind": "schedule",
      "required": true,
      "decision": "requiresConsent",
      "target": "heartbeat-summary",
      "source": "automations/heartbeat-summary.json",
      "reason": "This entry would require explicit user consent before a future install command mutates workspace files or automation state."
    }
  ],
  "diagnostics": [],
  "feed": {
    "id": "local-starter-claws",
    "name": "Local Starter Claws",
    "sourcePath": "/root/src/openclaw-claws-pr3/src/claws/fixtures/local-claws.feed.json",
    "entry": {
      "id": "incident-response",
      "name": "Incident Response",
      "version": "1.0.0",
      "source": "incident-response.claw.json",
      "publisher": "openclaw.examples",
      "description": "Starter claw for triage, workspace context, and response automation.",
      "owner": {
        "type": "publisher",
        "id": "openclaw.examples"
      },
      "trust": {
        "level": "source"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

Observed result after fix:
The feed inspect command returned `valid: true`, the resolved feed `sourcePath`, the full parsed feed object, and empty diagnostics. The feed plan command returned a read-only `openclaw.clawPlan.v1` payload with five planned entries, empty diagnostics, and the feed metadata tying `local-starter-claws` to the `incident-response` entry.

What was not tested:
Remote feed fetch, ClawHub publish/search, artifact install, workspace mutation, automation enablement, provenance writes, Gateway state changes, and lifecycle/update flows remain out of scope for PR3. Full-project typecheck could not complete in this linked worktree; changed-file TypeScript compile and targeted tests passed as listed above.

## Notes

I also attempted full-project typecheck paths:

- `node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p tsconfig.json --noEmit` could not run because `node_modules/.bin/tsgo` is missing in this worktree.
- direct `node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit --pretty false` OOMed at the default heap and again with `--max-old-space-size=8192`.
